gaps.description: A redis-py-compatible shared HealthStateStore and real Redis integration verifier exist, but the production redis client dependency, TLS/auth credential binding, connection pool sizing and service bootstrap wiring are not frozen into the Model Gateway runtime package. Redis remains short-lived operational state only; store failure falls back to UNKNOWN.

Synthetic probe policy and runner are implemented with explicit enabled, provider-terms, side-effect-free and cost gates. No live third-party synthetic probe is enabled until a provider-specific endpoint and terms are verified. Default policy executes nothing and permits no paid probe.

Manual disable, force-degraded, clear-override and clear-breaker contracts require actor/reason/TTL audit evidence, and PostgreSQL append-only audit persistence exists. Production authenticated Admin API/UI orchestration that persists the durable audit then applies the Redis override is not yet composed.

Health snapshots, transitions, append-only summaries and runtime counters expose the data required for provider_success_rate, provider_p95_latency, provider_429_rate, provider_circuit_state, fallback_rate and all_candidates_unavailable_total. Production metrics export, dashboards and critical-capability alert routing are deferred to NODE-67.

ProviderHealthPolicy supports per-provider/model/capability resolution, rolling windows, failure/rate-limit/timeout thresholds, latency and queue completion thresholds. Default values are safe engineering defaults, not production-calibrated SLOs; real traffic and provider behavior must calibrate profiles.

The inherited NODE-22 standalone lumi-api -> lumi-model-gateway workspace dependency/lock edge remains open. NODE-24 does not hand-edit uv.lock or claim a reviewed standalone service packaging boundary that has not been generated and validated.

Hosted GitHub Actions cannot be treated as PASS while the account payment/spending-limit condition prevents runner allocation. A job with runner_id=0 and steps=[] is external infrastructure evidence, not a source-code failure and not PASS.
